notes: S2-FIX2 U2 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; Q6, §5.5.2 step 1 in two tiers): an agent note cites a root grant that is present in the container but itself invalid (its valid_from T9 is after its valid_until T0, E_KEY_VALIDITY). The cited authorisation is present but invalid: the note is invalid E_GRANT_GRANTER (§5.4, §5.5.2 step 1, first tier), not unverifiable E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED.
